notes.title: Dayfly Artbook is out now!
notes.content: [h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900100"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3]In this artbook, you'll uncover:[/h3][p]- What the Sefirot of Death and Fire looks like[/p][p]- How many wings each incarnation of the Sefirot carries[/p][p]- Why the Dayfly was originally named Paula[/p][p]- Which ending could be considered the "true" one[/p][p]...and so much more about the enigmatic world of Sefirot and Dayflies.[/p][h3]As a gift you'll receive two exclusive avatars featuring the main heroines of the game.[/h3]
